purpose: Produce frontend experiences with product-specific visual identity, clear interaction, responsive composition, accessibility, and measured performance.
hard_rules: Lighthouse is not a design score
axe is not a complete accessibility audit
pixel similarity is not perceptual approval
mobile is recomposed, not merely shrunk desktop
known_limits: No current global frontend exercise proves exceptional visual identity or user validation.
Framework-specific guidance must be researched just in time.
